trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: Don’t accuse me for being late.
trap.right: Don’t accuse me of being late.
trap.why: Portugues “acusar de”; o brasileiro mistura com blame for. Accuse of / blame for.

fix.wrong: Don’t accuse me to be late.
fix.right: Don’t accuse me of being late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “You are late. I blame you.”
rewrite.answer: I blame you for being late.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “She blames me for the delay.”
rewrite.answer: She blamed me for the delay.
